big_case.notes: Potentially broad constitutional protection of intangible property and the source of Puerto Rico's immunity give substantial doctrinal stakes. The immediate dispute is a bounded trademark/license-plate controversy with contested preservation and vehicle issues. Denial creates no new merits precedent.
